derived_numbers_computed.evidence: The household's 2024 total (about $7.1 million) sums the non-memo FEC rows at the Houston address; the $5.95 million is MAGA Inc. plus the Trump 47 rows; Addison's 1.5% share is $300,000 of Protect Ohio Values' $19.8 million receipts.

outlet_claims_verified.evidence: The viral X post's $300,000 and 'recommended by Vance' lines were checked against the FEC rows and Reuters' own sourcing; 10 Things against Reuters; Reuters' 'chairman' against the advisory board's minutes; the $6 million and $7 million figures against the FEC rows.

live_elements_guarded.evidence: The page has no live element; the account figures are dated to KPMG's September 30 cutoff and the license term to Bloomberg's January 25 report.
